# To-Do List App

Create a simple To-Do List app that allows users to add, remove, and mark tasks as completed.

## Requirements

- Create a PHP script that interacts with a web page using DOM manipulation
- Use arrays to store task data
- Implement event handling to respond to user interactions
- Use if/else statements and loops to manage tasks
- Handle errors and edge cases
